title: Wes Anderson: The Lobby Boy's Caper
description: A pink box, a stolen portrait, and a country that never existed—five steps into Wes Anderson's grandest caper.
imageHint: A perfectly centered, symmetrical shot with vintage colors and meticulous production design

questions.question: Wes Anderson's 2014 caper follows the concierge M. Gustave and his lobby boy, Zero, at what pink mountaintop establishment?
questions.explanation: Hotel Chevalier is Anderson's own 2007 short, and the Darjeeling Limited is his train. The 1930s scenes are shot in the boxy 1.37:1 frame of films from that era.

questions.question: At the Grand Budapest, nothing says love like a pink box from Mendl's. What is the bakery's signature pastry?
questions.explanation: It's a riff on the real French religieuse. A pastry chef from Görlitz, where much of the film was shot, created the courtesan before working with Anderson on the final design.

questions.question: Courtesans smuggle tools into Gustave's prison, but the whole mess began with what priceless painting Madame D. left him?
questions.explanation: It's credited to the fictional "Johannes Van Hoytl the Younger," but British artist Michael Taylor really painted it in 2012 as a prop. A London dancer, Ed Munro, posed.

questions.question: Boy with Apple is the pride of what fictional European republic where the film is set?
questions.explanation: Anderson gave it a full history: belle époque glamour, a fascist takeover in the '30s, then Communist decline. Żubrówka is also a Polish bison-grass vodka.

questions.question: Zubrowka's world is credited, in the closing titles, to the writings of which Austrian author?
questions.explanation: Anderson fell for Zweig's novel Beware of Pity and his memoir The World of Yesterday, a portrait of a vanished pre-war Europe. The film is his love letter to it.

easterEgg.title: A lobby with a past
easterEgg.text: The hotel lobby is real: the Görlitzer Warenhaus, a 1913 department store in Görlitz, Germany, empty and near demolition when the crew moved in. Anderson reportedly came close to buying it.
